title: When Men Carried Clubs and Women Played Ding-Dong
writer: Fabio Pittorru, Massimo Felisatti, Bruno Corbucci
actors: Antonio Sabato, Aldo Giuffrè, Vittorio Caprioli
plot: Prehistoric cave-stud Ari wins lovely virgin Listra in a pig-catching contest, but their attempts at "Ding-Dong" keep getting interrupted by idiot battles between his tribe, The Cave Dwellers, and their neighbors, The Lake Dweller...
